cooperativeCancellationEvidence.testScheduling: Owned bootstrap adds bounded file barriers around real observation only; standard notifications/cancelled triggers the actual ACC cancellation/audit path
cooperativeCancellationEvidence.proofScope: Cooperative MCP cancellation while the ACC process remains alive permits inspection of its actual audit_tail records; no immediate child-kill durability guarantee is asserted

scope.actualHost: macOS27.0.1 arm64, single built-in Retina display
scope.executed: Fourteen real current-host MCP/App/receiver/shared-registry regressions and ten isolated Python suites, each once
scope.cancellation: Cooperative MCP cancellation before/after dispatch and nested macro ownership. The wrapper logs once and propagates cancellation; pixel changes retain confirmed=null.
scope.browser: Controlled fake resources and actual prepared Playwright startup cancellation against owned stubs. No real user browser was launched or controlled.
scope.clipboard: Only current-run native snapshot-restoration assertions are counted. Historical clipboard-loss evidence remains separate.
notExecuted: Workbench AbortSignal immediate bridge-process-tree kill with durable child-log guarantee
